nodes.label: O Painel de Sinal Vivo (Cosmos creative north star)
nodes.rationale: Instrument-panel identity: number as protagonist, frame silent, colour reserved for data, 'sem sinal' instead of fake zero.
nodes.norm_label: o painel de sinal vivo (cosmos creative north star)

nodes.label: The One Voice Rule
nodes.rationale: Lavender is the only brand accent, marking place, action and focus only; no second accent (old cyan, shadcn blue) allowed.

nodes.label: The Tone-Plus-Word Rule
nodes.rationale: State colour never stands alone; always paired with a Badge word or dot/pulse; green/red/amber exclusive to data surfaces.

nodes.label: The Scope Rule
nodes.rationale: Cosmos tokens only exist inside .cosmos-root; every portal must mount under that wrapper via CosmosPortal or inherit unscoped shadcn neutrals.

nodes.label: The Light-From-Above Rule
nodes.rationale: In dark theme every elevated surface gets a 1px light edge at the top; depth comes from above, never a hard lateral shadow.

nodes.label: The Glow-Is-Data Rule
nodes.rationale: Coloured glow only appears on data surfaces (KPI, tone bar, progress, live switch) or the primary CTA, never on nav/field/text.

nodes.label: The Clean-Light Rule
nodes.rationale: Dot-grid, engraved watermark and ECG texture are dark-theme-only signatures; light theme hides them and has no whole-page grain.

nodes.label: The Mono-for-Data Rule
nodes.rationale: Every id, number, percentage, date and code goes in JetBrains Mono (.mono); Manrope on an id loses the signal that it is data.

nodes.label: The Six Steps Rule
nodes.rationale: New font size must come from the six-step scale (micro..display); half-pixel steps do not separate label from title.

nodes.label: Motion spec vs implementation gap (M1-M18)
nodes.rationale: Big Bang·Charter·Cosmos micro-interaction spec compared line by line to code; several tokens/behaviors specified but not implemented.

nodes.label: Documented AA contrast debt (light theme fills)
nodes.rationale: White text on light green/amber solid fills fails AA; single --on-solid token cannot fix without per-tone foreground.
nodes.community_name: Documented AA contrast debt (light theme fills)
nodes.norm_label: documented aa contrast debt (light theme fills)

nodes.label: KPI ECG sparkline gradientUnits bug
nodes.rationale: linearGradient used userSpaceOnUse instead of objectBoundingBox; trace rendered invisible until fixed 2026-09-23.

nodes.label: KPI hover border/shadow inline-style override bug
nodes.rationale: Kit sets border/boxShadow inline in JS, which beats the CSS :hover rule, so tone border and shadow never light up on hover.
nodes.norm_label: kpi hover border/shadow inline-style override bug

nodes.label: KpiCard string-value parse bug
nodes.rationale: Kit parsed string values as numbers pre-2026-09-23, reading a pt-BR thousands dot as decimal (1.250.000 -> 1); fixed by passing numbers.

nodes.label: Dark-theme SSR hydration flash fix
nodes.rationale: Server always renders dark (theme lives in localStorage); hook now returns dark during hydration then the real theme, fixed 2026-09-23.

nodes.label: Light-theme ink-subtle token recalibration
nodes.rationale: ink-subtle was calibrated only against white (4.75:1); recalibrated 2026-09-23 against darkest real surface, shared via cosmos.css with back-office.
nodes.community_name: Documented AA contrast debt (light theme fills)

nodes.label: Value Realization boundary gap vs Signal
nodes.rationale: Cosmos screen creates business metrics and writes realized value by hand, but the boundary map assigns that ownership to Signal.
nodes.norm_label: value realization boundary gap vs signal

nodes.label: withSecureAction guard has no caller (custom roles inert)
nodes.rationale: The SRD's central guard is unused, so custom roles from /settings/roles authorize nothing and denials never reach the audit trail.
nodes.norm_label: withsecureaction guard has no caller (custom roles inert)

nodes.label: "Nenhuma tela inventa número" principle
nodes.rationale: Metric depending on uncollected data shows 'sem sinal', never zero/average/estimate; every list opens detail; every metric is derived.

nodes.label: Cosmos ICP (3+ ARTs or 100+ engineers, SAFe adopter)
nodes.norm_label: cosmos icp (3+ arts or 100+ engineers, safe adopter)

nodes.label: Meeting-transcription consent gate blocking first sale
nodes.rationale: Every transcript starts pending; the AI mapper only runs with per-meeting or standing consent; legal opinion on consent is the real blocker, not integrations.
nodes.norm_label: meeting-transcription consent gate blocking first sale

nodes.norm_label: shared base across charter/meridian/scaffold/signal (cosmos kit + charter/base.tsx)

nodes.label: No shared token file across the four product .css copies
nodes.rationale: charter.css/meridian.css/scaffold.css/signal.css are separate rescoped copies with no common file; changing one token means changing all four, and copies already diverge.
nodes.norm_label: no shared token file across the four product .css copies

nodes.label: ADR-0010: each product root is self-sufficient
nodes.rationale: Meridian must not bring in Cosmos's lavender accent (#5e6ad2) or import cosmos.css — each of the four raizes stays self-contained.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0010: each product root is self-sufficient

nodes.label: Gap severity uses fixed 60 instead of battery threshold
nodes.rationale: Severity computation should use the battery's own threshold but is hardcoded to 60, an integrity issue flagged for correction.
nodes.norm_label: gap severity uses fixed 60 instead of battery threshold

nodes.label: "Número defensável" principle
nodes.rationale: Every final score is traceable to answers or to a justified override, and the computed value is never erased by the override.
